audit_contract.purpose: Check whether source/test work can be accepted against accepted docs, frozen tests, verification, and methodology state.
intended_use: Use immediately before WorkItem status=done or lifecycle publish for source/test work.
Treat this as the recommended Station checklist/template the auditor is tuned for.
This gate protects against context drift: green tests alone are not enough if docs, frozen tests, and implementation diverged.

packet_template.description: Station-computed state: constitution, audit_gate, tests, implementation, blocking open questions, artifacts, next_required_profile.
WorkItem id, goal, status, owner, lifecycle_run_id, and evidence refs.
Accepted constitution/planning docs and document audit receipts.
Receipts proving blocking questions are resolved or explicitly deferred.
Frozen test manifest with hashes created before implementation acceptance.
Relevant source/test files or patch/apply receipts for the implementation under audit.
Station verification receipt with command, exit code, and bounded output.
Previous doc/route/conformance audit receipts, separated by profile_id to avoid cross-contamination.

audit_questions: Does the implementation satisfy the accepted project docs and explicit WorkItem goal without expanding scope?
Do frozen tests cover the behavior claimed by the implementation, and were they recorded as Station-owned evidence?
Did verification run after apply against the project tree, not only inside scratch?
Are source files, tests, and docs mutually consistent, or has the project drifted beyond the accepted constitution?
Is there any unresolved question, missing receipt, or same-agent self-acceptance risk that should block final acceptance?
pass_conditions: Accepted docs, frozen tests, implementation, and verification receipts are all present and consistent.
No blocking open questions remain for the accepted source/test change.
The implementation does not introduce behavior outside the accepted scope unless docs/tests were updated and audited first.
Verification passed after apply and the evidence chain is Station-owned.
fail_conditions: Implementation behavior conflicts with accepted docs, non-goals, WorkItem goal, or ADRs.
Tests were created/changed after implementation without a valid frozen-test receipt.
Verification failed, did not run after apply, or only checked scratch output.
The change expands project scope without prior doc update and doc audit.
The same logical agent self-accepted source/test work without independent audit or human override.
inconclusive_conditions: Any required packet section is missing, truncated past decision-critical content, or internally inconsistent.
The audit cannot distinguish accepted docs from draft/scaffold docs.
Verification, frozen-test, or apply receipts are referenced but not supplied.
forbidden_assumptions: Do not PASS only because tests are green.
Do not treat scaffold/TODO docs as accepted project intent.
Do not infer frozen-test timing from an agent summary; require Station-owned receipts.
Do not let failed conformance receipts count as failed doc audits; profile_id matters.
